name: Calabacitas con Elote
summary: Zucchini, corn, and tomato cooked down with melted cheese, served with rice and pinto beans.
instructions: Cook the rice: 300 g rice with 600 mL water, simmered covered for 15 minutes, then rested 5 minutes.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Cook the onion 4 minutes, then the garlic and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the zucchini and cook 5 minutes, stirring, until it starts to soften.
Add the tomatoes, corn, oregano, and 1 tsp salt. Simmer 8 minutes until the zucchini is tender and the liquid has mostly cooked off. Warm the beans in a small pot.
Take off the heat and stir in the cheese until melted. Serve with the rice and beans.

glutenFree.notes: Vegetables, beans, rice, and cheese are naturally gluten-free.

budgetNotes: Zucchini is cheap year-round at about $0.66 each and is priced here as whole items.
Leave out the cheese and use more beans for a vegan version, at about $10.45.
Also good as a taco filling with corn tortillas.
